title: Tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital, Nasdaq CEO says
description: Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman said tokenization could free up tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital.

title: Little relief expected for gas prices ahead of Election Day, according to prediction markets
description: Gas prices are expected to remain above $4 per gallon on Nov. 3, according to traders on prediction market platform Kalshi.

description: A recovery in China's largest cities real estate markets could come as soon as next year, the S&P ratings agency said.

description: Chinese tech company Huawei wants to rebuild its consumer business after U.S. sanctions halved segment revenue.

title: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its Sept. 15-16 policy meeting.

title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
description: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

title: Chart: A look at the S&P 500's remarkable and defiant trip to a new record

title: How event contract bundles are boosting volume on prediction markets
description: Combo contracts are driving volume growth even as they make up a small, albeit consistent, share of transactions.

title: Goldman: Diesel prices set to stay high through 2027 as refineries struggle to meet demand

title: House Democrat targets candidate prediction market trades after opponent’s Kalshi penalty
description: A new bill bans federal candidates from trading prediction market contracts related to their own elections and would result in a fine if violated.

title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
description: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a runoff on Oct. 25.

title: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z.  Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
description: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.

description: With the first round of Brazil's presidential election taking place Sunday, Wall Street is gearing up with starkly different market predictions.

title: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
description: Odds tumbled after a jobs report showed a soft labor market, leading more traders to lower the the chances of a fed funds rate increase this month.

title: Bitget 'not expecting to recover a lot' from $388 million hack, CEO tells CNBC

title: Singapore's Temasek to expand Middle East presence, open Abu Dhabi, Riyadh offices
